title: Case report: Tunneling foreign body in the metatarsal bones of a dog
caption: Lateral and dorsoplantar view of the right metatarsus showed mid-diaphyseal, well delineated, horizontal lysis of metatarsals 2–5, with ovoid, discrete geographic lysis of metatarsals 2 and 5. Smoothly marginated new bone is seen on the lateral aspect of metatarsal 5 and the plantar aspect of the metatarsals on the lateral view. Moderate soft tissue swelling was noted surrounding the lucencies with a subtle dorsal indentation of the soft tissues (arrow) at the level of the boney lysis best seen on the lateral view.
authors: Wagoner H, Holland M, Pansini K, McCarthy J, Fiske K
